summary.scope: Native polynomial curve mechanics and authored reconstruction on supplied anonymous endpoints; no dataset import, bitmap recognition, learned likelihood or measured curve parameters.
summary.dependence: One pooled estimated compatibility event per source; macro envelope, tangent, bend, join and micro reads are not independent copies of the source evidence.
summary.archive: Separate evaluator source/correspondence branch and public receiver branch. Private handles are retained for audit, never supplied to reconstruction or assessment.
summary.interior: Explicit oriented-boundary premise; closure does not imply convexity or establish interior.
